name: Suspect perception
description: Sight, hearing, reaction time, and stress

Suspects will trigger an evaluation event every {value} seconds to peek behind covers in order to check if there's any SWAT. If not, they will leave the cover

AI stress will naturally decrease or increase depending on how aggressive your team is. AI in high stress will not hesitate to shoot you and be combative, while AI in low stress will not be as aggressive.
